note: Definitive S3 evaluation. The learned stage was trained (values-only, calibrated, train-only) and measured on the FROZEN HOLDOUT, which had been used for nothing else. AUC is threshold-free (benign vs claimed classes). This supersedes the val-based and ECML-only numbers.
model: char_wb 2-5gram TF-IDF + calibrated LogisticRegression, values-only (no provenance tags)
root_cause: S3 keys on the character n-grams of benign parameter VALUES. On the frozen holdout, whose benign values are novel, it defaults to its ~0.888 prior and over-fires. The val 0.9993 was optimistic because val's benign values resembled train's. It learns benign value patterns, not transferable attack structure.
verdict: Does not generalise. OFF by default; advisory-only if enabled (never blocks). The cascade's detection is S1+S2 (94.3% claimed recall at 0.00% FPR on this same holdout), which does not need S3. A per-deployment model trained and calibrated on the operator's own traffic (scripts/train_s3.py + scripts/calibrate.py) is the only defensible way to enable it.
